summary: Iteration 3 verified RAG-powered Chat-with-PDF, AI-tile visibility regression, and full backend regression from iteration 2. Backend: 43/43 pytest pass. Added 4 new RAG-focused tests (payload shape, page-1 relevance for person query, page-2 relevance for invoice query, cache/hash persistence, MongoDB rag_indexes entry). Frontend: all 8 AI tiles (ai-chat, ai-summarize, ai-audiobook, ai-redact, ai-extract, ai-math, ai-ocr, ai-visual-diff) render with coral bg rgb(255,98,66) and white text rgb(255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark modes on / with cat-ai filter active. /t/ai-chat page shows question textarea (opt-question), tool-run button, and upload zone. Geo billing, Stripe checkout, payments status all still pass.

minor.issue: RAG uses TF-IDF (sklearn) rather than neural embeddings — acceptable per spec (Emergent proxy has no embeddings endpoint). Cosine-sim on short 2-page PDFs works but may struggle with paraphrased queries; consider hybrid BM25+TFIDF or sentence-transformers when available.
RAG index blob stored as pickled+base64 TfidfVectorizer inside MongoDB doc — pickle across sklearn versions can break; consider storing vocab_ + IDF weights as JSON, or re-fit on load.
(carried from iter 2) webhook_url derived from request.base_url — still resolves to internal Kubernetes URL. Stripe cannot POST to it. Use PUBLIC_BASE_URL env.

issues: ACTION panel renders an empty-looking white box for the Run button when logged out — the tool-run element exists but visually reads as blank (only faint border). Consider showing 'LOG IN TO RUN' text or disabled state label for anonymous users.
Copy says '53 tools' but tools registry returns 52 base tools; hero indicator shows '01 / 52'. Minor inconsistency.

action_items: Optional: replace pickled TfidfVectorizer blob in rag_indexes with a JSON-safe representation to avoid future sklearn-version pickle breakage.
Optional: show a clearer disabled state for the Run button on /t/ai-chat when the user is logged out (currently visually blank).
Still open from iter 2: derive Stripe webhook_url from PUBLIC_BASE_URL env instead of request.base_url.
critical_code_review_comments: rag.py stores base64(pickle(TfidfVectorizer, matrix)) in Mongo — works but couples cache to exact sklearn version and Python pickle protocol. If sklearn is upgraded, cached entries will fail to deserialize. Recommend adding a version marker and rebuild-on-mismatch, or serialize vocabulary + IDF vector to JSON.

rag.get_or_build_index does a synchronous pdf_ops.extract_text_by_page + TfidfVectorizer.fit_transform inside the request path — for large PDFs this blocks the event loop. Consider running inside asyncio.to_thread / a threadpool executor.
server.py ai_chat consumes credits BEFORE calling ai_service.chat_with_rag; if the LLM call errors out, the user still lost 1 credit. Consider credit refund on exception or consume-after-success.

rag.retrieve fallback returns even zero-similarity chunks when nothing scores >0 — good UX, but citations then have score 0.0 which could mislead users. Consider filtering with a small floor (e.g., 0.01) and returning empty citations list rather than noise.
